name: COMPOUND_UNION_ALL_PRESERVES_DUPES
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3;

name: COMPOUND_UNION_DEDUPLICATES
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3;

name: COMPOUND_INTERSECT
description: INTERSECT returns rows common to both sides (deduplicated)

name: COMPOUND_EXCEPT
description: EXCEPT returns rows from left not present on right (deduplicated)

name: COMPOUND_MIXED_LEFT_TO_RIGHT
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 INTERSECT SELECT 2;

name: COMPOUND_ORDER_BY_FINAL
description: ORDER BY on compound applies to the final unified result
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 ORDER BY 1;

name: COMPOUND_LIMIT
description: LIMIT on compound trims the final result
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 LIMIT 2;

name: COMPOUND_LIMIT_OFFSET
description: OFFSET with LIMIT on compound skips initial rows
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 2;

name: COMPOUND_DIFFERENT_COLUMN_COUNT_ERRORS
description: Compound with mismatched column counts is rejected at parse time
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT 1,2 UNION SELECT 3;

name: COMPOUND_COLUMN_NAMES_FROM_LEFTMOST
description: Compound result inherits column names from the leftmost SELECT
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
.headers on
SELECT 1 AS alpha UNION SELECT 2;
.headers off

name: COMPOUND_VALUES_OPERAND
description: VALUES (...) functions as a compound operand
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
VALUES (1,'a'),(2,'b') UNION ALL VALUES (3,'c');

name: COMPOUND_WHERE_PER_SIDE
description: Each side of a compound carries its own WHERE clause

name: COMPOUND_PRESERVES_TYPED_NULLS
description: Compound with NULL on one side carries through to output
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT 1, 'a' UNION ALL SELECT NULL, NULL UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'b';

name: COMPOUND_DISTINCT_INSIDE_VS_UNION
description: SELECT DISTINCT inside a UNION ALL vs UNION-level dedup

name: COMPOUND_ORDER_BY_ORDINAL
description: ORDER BY ordinal column reference on a compound
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT 2,'b' UNION ALL SELECT 1,'a' UNION ALL SELECT 3,'c' ORDER BY 1;
